title: Knee lifts

steps.text: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your belly gently firm.
Lift one knee toward hip height and touch it with the opposite hand.
steps.cue: Knee up. Touch it with the opposite hand.

steps.text: Lower it and lift the other knee. Keep the standing knee a little bent.
Keep your back straight and your rhythm steady.

mistakes: Curling the back down to meet the knee.
regression: Lift your knees lower, and keep one hand on a wall.
stopIf: Stop if you feel dizzy, sick, very short of breath, or any pain in your chest.

anatomy.why: The front of the hip lifts the knee while the standing hip keeps you level.
